artworks.title: Fallen
artworks.inspiration: A study in shadow, vulnerability, and transformation. Black wings, still water, and a dark reflection create a fallen-angel atmosphere.

artworks.title: Divine
artworks.inspiration: A celestial counterpoint to Fallen: luminous wings, violet starlight, and a cosmic setting explore softness, wonder, and transcendence.

artworks.title: Daisy Dreams
artworks.inspiration: Inspired by the quiet romance of a summer meadow at golden hour. Soft pink ribbons, delicate daisies, and warm light frame a dreamy, storybook-inspired portrait.

artworks.title: Cherry Blossom Hearts
artworks.inspiration: A playful candy-colored dream where rose-gold chrome hearts curl through cherry blossoms, glossy flowers, and a pastel-blue sky. Inspired by kawaii pop fantasy and springtime romance.

artworks.title: Cloud Nine
artworks.inspiration: An airy pastel fantasy of smiling clouds, butterflies, mirrored hearts, and lavender blooms. Inspired by the softness of daydreams and the joy of imaginative editorial art.
